special_rules.name: Adamantium Will
special_rules.text: When a unit with this special rule is targeted for an attack by a weapon with the Psychic Weapon special rule or by a Psychic Power. The attack from the Psychic Weapon or Psychic Power is resolved with -1 to all hit rolls and -1 to all wound rolls from that weapon.

special_rules.name: Assault Vehicle
special_rules.text:
Models Embarked in a transport with this special rule are subject to the following:

- Embarked models can shoot and Fight in the shooting Phase and Combat Phase while embarked as normal.
- All measurement and line of sight is measured from the Vehicles hull.
- Units embarked can only ever make 1 attack in the combat phase.
- Unless the embarked unit disembarks during the turn, the embarked unit is considered to have made the same type of movement as the transport for the purposes of determining modifiers and eligibility to shoot.
- When a transport is slain, destroyed, wrecked or explodes with this special rule. Models that disembark are slain on a roll of a 1 or a 2 instead of a 1.
- If a Transport with this special rule is Pinned, the embarked models count as being Pinned as well.

special_rules.name: Battle Smith

parameter.description: the number of Machine Rites that the unit can attempt in each phase

special_rules.text: In the Shooting Phase, a model with this special rule may forfeit its Shooting Attack to attempt perform a Machine Rite. The Machine Rites available to a unit are listed in their relevant Codex. The value of (x) is the number of Machine Rites a unit may attempt to perform each phase. To perform a Machine Rite, the unit performing it must make a Leadership Test. If the roll is equal to or lower than the units Leadership (LD) characteristic, the test is passed, and the Machine Rite is successfully performed. If the roll is greater than the units Leadership (LD) characteristic, the test is failed, and Rite is not performed. If a unit with more than 1 model with this special rule wishes to perform a Rite, only 1 model in the unit must forfeit its Shooting Attack. A unit with the Firing Protocols (x) special rule, can forfeit one of its Shooting Attacks to perform any number of Machine Rites equal to the value of Battle Smith (x). A unit cannot perform the same Rite more than once per Phase unless otherwise stated.

special_rules.name: Battle-Hardened
special_rules.text: A model with this special rule treats its Toughness (T) characteristic as being 1 higher for the purposes of determining Instant Death. This does not affect standard to wound rolls.

special_rules.name: Bulky

parameter.description: the number of models that each model counts as for transport capacity

special_rules.text: Each model in a unit with this special rule counts as a number of models equal to the value of X for transport capacity in Transports.

special_rules.name: Character
special_rules.text:
A unit with this special rule may be attached to another unit of the same type which consists of 2 or more models during deployment. The unit with this special rule cannot leave its unit and join another unit unless all models from the previously attached unit have been slain.

A unit with this special rule does not confer any special rules or affects they have unless specifically stated. A unit with this special rule is treated as being a part of its attached unit for all purposes including movement, targeting, reactions and wounds allocation.

Vehicle, Knight, Titan, Aircraft or Fortification type units with this special rule cannot join units.

A unit which includes an attached unit with this special rule that has an alternative deployment option (Outflank, Deep Strike, etc) may only use that option if both units have the alternative deployment option.

Only 1 unit with this special rule may attached to a unit without this special rule at any given time.

To join a new unit, the Character must end its movement phase within coherency of the new unit they wish to attach to.

If a Character or its attached unit Set to perform a Reaction, both units are counted as Set to perform a Reaction. Both units do not need to be able to perform the same Reaction.

special_rules.name: Counter Attack
special_rules.text: When a unit with this special rule is charged, it gains +1 to its Attacks (A) characteristic until the end of the following Combat Phase.

special_rules.name: Crusader
special_rules.text: A unit with this special rule, rolls an extra D6 when performing a Sweeping Advance roll.

special_rules.name: Deep Strike
special_rules.text:
A unit with this special rule can be placed off the board in reserves during deployment (see 3.1). At the start of your movement phase, starting in the second battle round, place the unit placed in reserves with this special rule on the battlefield anywhere more than 3" away from any enemy models and roll a D6.

- 1-2: Mishap!: The unit is removed from play and the battlefield and placed back into reserve instead of being deployed. If a unit Mishaps they are considered to have never arrived on the Battlefield and may be destroyed if they have not arrived by the end of Round 4.
- 3-4: Minimal Deviation: The opponent scatters the unit within 5" of where it was placed on the battlefield.
- 5-6: Perfect landing: The unit arrives where its placed, on target and does not scatter.

If a rule states that units arriving does not scatter when arriving from Deep Strike, the Roll is treated as having been a 5+. Units that arrive Via Deep Strike may not Move in the Movement Phase they arrive. Units that arrive via Deep Strike may charge in the Charge Phase on the turn they arrive. Units that arrive count as having moved during the turn they arrive. Units that arrive within 1" of an enemy unit or in terrain must take a Dangerous Terrain test for each of its models. Units within a Transport model that arrived via Deep Strike may disembark the Movement Phase the model arrives. Models must be placed in Coherency and base contact. Units may not Disembark from Vehicle and Aircraft type units which arrived via the Deep Strike that turn.

special_rules.name: Deny the Witch
special_rules.text: Enemy Psyker units within 24" and Line of sight of a model from a unit with this special rule suffer -1 to their Leadership (LD) characteristic when attempting to cast a Psychic power.

special_rules.name: Fade & Fire
special_rules.text: A model with this special rule may perform a Retreat move in the Movement Phase and still Shoot in the Shooting Phase at full Ballistic Skill (BS).

special_rules.name: Expendable
special_rules.text: A unit with this special rule does not count as contesting an objective if an enemy model is also within 6" of the objective marker. A unit with this special rule never counts for Victory Points when slain.

special_rules.name: Fear

parameter.description: the negative modifier to the Leadership of enemy units within 3"

special_rules.text: Enemy units within 3" of a model from a unit with this special rule suffer a negative modifier equal to the value of (x) to their Leadership (LD) Characteristic.

special_rules.name: Feel No Pain

parameter.description: the roll that ignores the wound

special_rules.text:
When a model in a unit with the Feel no Pain Special rule is allocated a wound, you may roll a dice. If the roll is equal to or higher than (X) next to the Special rules name, the wound is ignored (see 9.3).

E.g: For Feel no Pain (5+), a roll of 5 or higher is required to ignore the wound when allocating it.

special_rules.name: Fire Points

parameter.description: the number of embarked models that can make shooting attacks

special_rules.text: A number of Infantry type models embarked on a unit with this special rule may make Shooting Attacks in the Shooting Phase equal to value of X. The embarked units draw line of sight from the hull of the unit with this special rule and count as being Stationary.

special_rules.name: Firing Protocols

parameter.description: the number of different weapons that the unit can attack with

special_rules.text: A unit with this special rule may attack in the shooting phase with a number of different weapons equal to the value of (x). Each weapon may target a different unit.

special_rules.name: Fleet
special_rules.text: A unit with this special rule can Advance and still declare a Charge in the Charge Phase. (see 6.3).

special_rules.name: Fly
special_rules.text:
A unit with this special rule ignores other models and terrain features when you trace the path of its move across the battlefield (it flies over them). In addition, when a model in a unit with this special rule starts or finishes a move on a terrain feature, instead of tracing its move across the battlefield, you can trace it through the air.

A flying model cannot finish its move on top of another model or finish any Normal Move, Advance, or Retreat within 3" of any enemy models. Models with Fly are not subject to Dangerous or Difficult Terrain rules when passing through such terrain but will still take Dangerous Terrain Tests (per 7.3.5) if they end their move on top of such terrain unless they are an Aircraft.

Units with the Fly special rule may Retreat and still shoot in the shooting phase at their full Ballistic Skill (BS). Units with this special rule may Charge Aircraft type units.

special_rules.name: Frenzy
special_rules.text: If a unit with this special rule has had any wounds allocated to it that are not ignored or models from the unit have been slain, then for the rest of the game, it gains +1 Attacks (A) Characteristic but must always attempt to charge if it is within 12" of an enemy unit and did not Advance or Retreat in the previous Movement phase (see 11.0).

special_rules.name: Furious Charge

parameter.description: the value of the rule. The text gives +1 Strength and does not use the value

special_rules.text: A unit with the Furious Charge special rule gains +1 to its Strength (S) Characteristic in the Combat Phase if it successfully charged in the previous Charge Phase.

special_rules.name: Hammer of Wrath

parameter.description: the number of Hammer of Wrath attacks of each model

special_rules.text:
At Initiative step 10 during the Fight sequence (see 12.1), every model in the unit in melee range may makes a number of attacks equal to the value of X at Strength User attack with AP6 so long as the unit completed a charge that turn. The models then proceed to pile in and attack normally at their regular Initiative (I) characteristics or modified Initiative (I) characteristics.

If the unit with this special rule is a Vehicle, Walker, Monster, or Automata with a Wound (W) characteristic of 4 or greater, the attack has AP2. Hammer of Wrath attacks are only ever made in the first round of a combat. These attacks hit automatically.

special_rules.name: Hatred

parameter.description: the unit type or keyword of the enemy units. No value: all enemy units

special_rules.text: A model from a unit with this special rule can re-roll wound rolls of 1 against enemy units. Where the (x) following the special rule has a unit type (see 17.0) or Keyword, the unit can only re-roll wound rolls of 1 against units with that specific type or Keyword. If no type or keyword is indicated by an (x), the unit re-rolls all wound rolls of 1 regardless of type or keyword of the target enemy unit.

special_rules.name: Hit & Run
special_rules.text: At initiative 0 before step 8 of the Fight Sequence (see 12.1), a unit with this rule can opt to hit and run. The unit must take an Initiative test. Roll a D6. If it's lower than or equal to the unit's Initiative (I) characteristic, the test is passed the unit may immediately make a normal move as if it were the movement phase (see 6.1) and the attack sequence ends. If it fails, proceed to step 8 of the Fight Sequence (see 12.1).

special_rules.name: Hover
special_rules.text: An Aircraft with this Special rule must declare at the start of its movement phase if it will Hover or Fly. If the unit Hovers, it gains +1 to its Ballistic Skill (BS) characteristic and its Movement (M) characteristic becomes 12". Hovering Aircraft units can be charged by units without the Fly special rule, measuring distances to the Aircraft's base. An Aircraft unit that is Hovering does not automatically explode when immobilised. A unit Hovering is no longer hit on 6+ by enemy shooting attacks. An Aircraft is treated as a Vehicle type while the unit is Hovering.

special_rules.name: Infiltrate
special_rules.text: At the end of the deployment step after deployment but before the first turn begins, units with this special rule may be placed anywhere on the board, instead of in your deployment zone but may not be placed within the enemy deployment zone. If both players have units that can infiltrate, players take turns alternating between deploying infiltrating units, starting with the player that is the Attacker in the Scenario. Infiltrating units cannot deploy within 6" of another Infiltrating unit.

special_rules.name: Last Stand
special_rules.text: Models in a unit with this special rule may still fight in the Combat phase even if they would be slain before they are eligible to fight. If a model with this special rule is slain before it gets to fight, it may fight at Initiative 1. Do not remove the slain model until after it has fought.

special_rules.name: Monster Hunter
special_rules.text: Models in a unit with this special rule may re-roll wound rolls against units with the Monster type.

special_rules.name: Move Through Cover
special_rules.text: Models in a unit with this special rule ignore the effects of Difficult terrain and Dangerous Terrain.

special_rules.name: Outflank
special_rules.text: A unit with this special rule can be placed off the board in reserves during deployment (see 3.1). At the start of your movement phase, starting in the second battle round, you can roll a D6 for each unit in reserves. On a roll of a 3+, you can place a unit with this special rule on the board anywhere wholly within a number of inches equal to its Movement (M) characteristic of any board edge and more than 6" away from any enemy models. This counts as a Normal Move. The unit may not make any additional moves the turn it arrives but may declare charges in the charge phase.

special_rules.name: Preferred Enemy

parameter.description: the unit type or keyword of the enemy units. No value: all enemy units

special_rules.text: A model from a unit with this special rule can re-roll hit rolls of 1 against enemy units. Where the (x) following the special rule has a unit type (see 17.0) or Keyword, the unit can only re-roll hit of 1 against units with that specific type or Keyword. If no type or keyword is indicated by an (x), the unit re-rolls all hit rolls of 1 regardless of type or keyword of the target enemy unit.

special_rules.name: Priest

parameter.description: the number of Prayers that the unit can attempt in each phase

special_rules.text: In the Shooting Phase, a model with this special rule may to attempt perform a Prayer. The Prayer available to a unit are listed in their relevant Codex. The value of (x) is the number of Prayer a unit may attempt to perform each phase. To perform a Prayer, the unit performing it must make a Leadership Test. If the roll is equal to or lower than the units Leadership (LD) characteristic, the test is passed, and the Prayer is successfully performed. If the roll is greater than the units Leadership (LD) characteristic, the test is failed, and Prayer is not performed. If a unit with more than 1 model with this special rule wishes to perform a Prayer, only 1 model in the unit performs the Prayer. A unit cannot chant the same prayer more than once per Phase unless otherwise stated.

special_rules.name: Psyker

parameter.description: the number of Psychic Powers or Psychic Weapons that the unit can attempt in each phase

special_rules.text:
In the Shooting Phase, a model with this special rule may attempt cast a Psychic Power or Psychic Weapon. The Power/Weapon available to a unit are listed in their relevant Codex. The value of (x) is the number of Powers/Weapons a unit may attempt to cast each phase. To perform a Psychic Power/Psychic Weapon, the unit performing it must make a Leadership Test referred to as a Psychic test. If the roll is equal to or lower than the units Leadership (LD) characteristic, the test is passed, and the Psychic Power/Weapon is successfully performed or may resolve an attack with the Psychic Weapon. If the roll is greater than the units Leadership (LD) characteristic, the test is failed, and Power/Weapon is not cast. If a unit with more than 1 model with this special rule wishes to cast a Psychic Power/Weapon, the power is measured from 1 model in the unit. If a unit with this special rule, when performing its Leadership Test rolls a double 6 or a double 1, suffers a Peril of the Warp and it must immediately roll on the following Perils table after resolving its Psychic Power/Weapon. A unit cannot cast the same power more than once per phase unless otherwise stated.

D6	Result
1	Nothing happens…. For now.
2	The Psyker takes 1 automatic wound with no saves allowed.
3	The Psyker takes D3 automatic wounds with no saves.
4	The Psyker cannot cast anymore powers in this Shooting Phase.
5	The Psyker is empowered and gains +1 to its Strength and Toughness until the end of the round.
6	The Psyker is pulled into the warp and killed. The Psyker is killed instantly and is slain. Remove them from the board.

special_rules.name: Rage
special_rules.text: At the start of the Combat Phase, a unit with this special rule can choose to increase every model in the unit's Attack (A) characteristic by 1 but all models in the unit suffer -1 to their Weapon Skill (WS) characteristic until the end of the Phase.

special_rules.name: Regeneration
special_rules.text: At the start of your movement phase, roll 1D6. On a roll of a 5+, one model in the unit heals 1 wound (9.4).

special_rules.name: Relentless
special_rules.text: Models in a unit with this special rule can move and fire Heavy Weapons at their full Ballistic Skill (BS) (see 8.4.1). In addition, units with this special rule may declare a charge move in the Charge Phase, even if they made a shooting attack with a Heavy or Rapid Fire weapon.

special_rules.name: Scout
special_rules.text: A Unit with this special rule can, after deployment but before the first battle round begins, make a normal move as if it were the movement phase (see 6.1). A unit that used the Infiltrate special rule to deploy may not make a Scout move.

special_rules.name: Indomitable Spirit

parameter.description: the invulnerable save against Psychic weapons

special_rules.text: Models with this special rule may make an Invulnerable save equal to x against Psychic weapons.

special_rules.name: Night Vision
special_rules.text: A unit with this special rule ignores the Night Fighting rules in Battle plans where it is active.

special_rules.name: Siege Attackers
special_rules.text: The unit with this special rule can re-roll all rolls to penetrate against units with the Fortification type (see 8.5.7).

special_rules.name: Skilled Rider
special_rules.text: A unit with this special rule always counts as having a Light Cover save. If the unit with this special rule advanced during their previous movement phase, they have a Heavy Cover save.

special_rules.name: Slow and Purposeful
special_rules.text: A unit with this special rule may not make Reactions except for setting to Smoke (see 12.2) and may not Advance (see 6.3) or Sweeping Advance (see 12.3.5).

special_rules.name: Sprint

parameter.description: the inches that the unit adds to its Advance moves and Charge moves

special_rules.text: A unit with the Sprint Special rule adds the value of (x) to all Advance moves (see 6.3) and Charge moves they make (see 11.1).

special_rules.name: Stubborn
special_rules.text: A Unit that has this special rule never suffers any negative modifiers to their Leadership (LD) Characteristic.

special_rules.name: Sudden Strike
special_rules.text: A unit with the Sudden Strike special rule adds 1 to its Initiative (I) characteristic in the combat phase after it has completed a charge move (see 11.1). If the character has Initiative 1 from an Unwieldy weapon in the Combat Phase, their Initiative is still increased by the value of 1 (Initiative 1 becomes Initiative 2).

special_rules.name: Super Heavy

parameter.description: the number of Structure Points

special_rules.text:
A Vehicle/Knight/Titan/Aircraft with the Super Heavy (X) special rule gains the following benefits:

- The Vehicle/Aircraft has a number of Structure points equal to the value of X. Each time the Vehicle/Aircraft suffers a Critical result on the Vehicle damage chart that would cause it to be wrecked or explode, it instead loses 1 Structure Point. If the Vehicle/Aircraft has no more Structure points when it suffers a Critical damage result on the Vehicle damage chart, the Critical result is resolved as normal instead.
- When a Vehicle/Aircraft with this special rule would suffer a Critical result on the Vehicle Damage chart that would cause it to explode, it instead explodes 10", hitting all models within range with 1 Strength 6, AP4 hit.
- When a Walker with this special rule would be reduced to 0 wounds, it explodes 10", hitting all models within range with 1 Strength 6, AP4 hit.
- A model with this special rule may move and still fire weapons with the Ordnance Special rule.
- When a model with this special rule suffers an Immobilised result on the Vehicle Damage Chart, it instead halves its Movement (M) characteristic. This may be repaired by a unit with the Battle Smith (x) special rule in place of an Immobilized result.

special_rules.name: Tank Hunters
special_rules.text: The unit with this special rule can roll 2D6 on the Vehicle damage chart when resolving penetrating hits and pick which result will be applied (see 10.1).

special_rules.name: Skirmisher
special_rules.text: A unit with the Skirmisher special rule has a 3" horizontal coherency and 9" vertical coherency. In addition, the unit gains +1 to its Cover Saves (Max of 4+) when receiving the benefits of Cover.

special_rules.name: Support Squad
special_rules.text: A unit with this special rule may not be fielded as a compulsory choice in your army Force Organization Chart.

special_rules.name: Zealot
special_rules.text: A unit with the Zealot special rule adds 1 to its Attacks (A) Characteristic in the combat phase after it has completed a charge move (see 11.1).

special_rules.name: Arcing

parameter.description: the hit roll that inflicts 2 hits

special_rules.text: Each to hit roll inflicts 2 hits with this weapon instead of 1 if the to Hit roll was equal to or greater than the value of (x). Resolve each hit separately.

special_rules.name: Bane

parameter.description: the keyword or unit type of the target units. No value: all target units

special_rules.text: A unit hit by a weapon with this special rule that has the (x) keyword or unit type may not make Invulnerable saves against wounds caused by a weapon with this special rule. If no type or keyword is indicated by an (x), the unit ignores all Invulnerable saves with the weapon regardless of type or keyword of the target enemy unit.

special_rules.name: Barrage

parameter.description: the number of additional hits

special_rules.text: When determining the number of models hit by a Blast or Large Blast weapon, a weapon with this special rule scores an additional number of hits equal to the value of X. Distribute these additional hits to units within range of the blast marker as evenly as possible rounding up.

special_rules.name: Blast

parameter.description: the size of the Blast Marker: Small or Large

special_rules.text:
Instead of rolling to hit normally with a weapon with this trait during step 1 of the shooting attack sequence (see 8.5), place the centre of a Blast Marker anywhere on the battlefield within the weapon's range and line of sight, while touching at least one model from the target unit, then make the hit roll.

If a hit is scored, models within 2" (for Blast (Small)) or 3" (for Blast (Large)) of the markers take one hit each, rolling for wounds and saves as normal.

If a miss was scored, the opposing player may move the marker/change the target point D6" (for Blast (Small) or D6+2" (for Blast (Large)) in any direction of their choosing. The centre of the marker may not be scattered or placed off the board. After moving the marker, all models within 2" (for Blast (Small)) or 3" (for Blast (Large)), take one hit each from the weapon, rolling for wounds and saves as normal.

Measurements for determining what is hit are to a model's base unless it doesn't have one.

For determining Cover and AV facings, draw line of sight from the attackers direction and not the blast marker.

The Blast Special rule targets a unit but cannot be fired if the unit making the attack would be subject to Snap Shots as a result of a movement action or other effect. A unit which is required to make snap shots may not fire a weapon with the Blast special rule under any circumstances.

special_rules.name: Blind
special_rules.text: A unit hit by a weapon with this special rule may not make Reactions. i.e. Overwatch, Counter Charge, etc. In addition, when a weapon with this special rule resolves a hit against an enemy unit, the target unit hit by this weapon's attack halves its Ballistic Skill (BS) & Weapon Skill (WS) characteristic until the end of the following combat phase (see 12.1). This does not affect Vehicle, Fortification, Aircraft, Knight or Titan type units.

special_rules.name: Piercing
special_rules.text: A weapon with this special rule is treated as being Strength x2 if the equipped model successfully completed a Charge in the previous Charge Phase.

special_rules.name: Bombing Run
special_rules.text: In the shooting phase, this weapon can be used to make an attack against one enemy unit that the equipped model passed over in the previous movement phase (see 7.3.7). Weapons with this special rule always hit a Vehicle, Knight or Titans Rear Armour. This weapon cannot target or resolve hits against units with the Fly special rule.

special_rules.name: Concussive
special_rules.text: When a weapon with this special rule resolves a hit against an enemy unit, the target unit hit by this weapon's attack halves its Initiative (I) characteristic until the end of the following combat phase (see 12.1). This does not affect Vehicle, Walker, Aircraft, Knight, Fortification or Titan type units.

special_rules.name: Crushing

parameter.description: the wound roll that inflicts 2 wounds

special_rules.text: A weapon with the Crushing special rule inflicts 2 wounds instead of 1 if the to Wound roll was equal to or greater than the roll represented by (x). Make a save roll for each wound inflicted separately.

special_rules.name: Cumbersome
special_rules.text: A melee weapon with this rule can only ever make a single attack in the combat phase, regardless of its Attacks (A) characteristics or from extra close combat weapons. You may claim the bonus for Charging.

special_rules.name: Force
special_rules.text: At the Beginning of Combat, a model equipped with a weapon that has this special rule may make a Psychic Test per Casting a Psychic Power (see 16.0). If the Psychic test is successful, all wounds inflicted by the weapon with this special rule count as Instant Death Wounds until the end of the Combat Phase. If the target is a Monster, Primarch, Walkers or Automata, it inflicts D3 Wounds instead.

special_rules.name: Gets Hot!
special_rules.text: When a weapon with the Gets Hot special rule rolls a 1 to hit, the model firing the weapon takes 1 automatic wound at AP-. They may take an armour save as normal against that wound (see 8.5). If a Vehicle suffers Gets Hot! the weapon with this special rule is destroyed as if the vehicle suffered the effects of a Weapon Destroyed Result on the Vehicle Damage Chart.

special_rules.name: Haywire

parameter.description: the roll that always wounds or penetrates

special_rules.text:
A weapon with this special rule always scores a wound or penetrating hit against Vehicles, Automata, Walkers, Knight, Aircraft, Battlesuit, Drones on a roll of X as represented next to the rule.

All other unit types use the weapons base strength instead.

If when comparing the weapons Strength characteristic against the targets Toughness or Armour Value characteristic, the wound roll required is lower than the Haywire roll indicated in the brackets or vice-versa, use the lowest required to Wound or Penetrate roll for determining if the weapon inflicts a wound or Penetrating Hit on the target. Haywire (X) is not considered a triggered effect (see 1.7.4).

special_rules.name: Ignores Cover
special_rules.text: Cover saves cannot be taken against a weapon with this special rule (see 8.5.2).

special_rules.name: Murderous Strike

parameter.description: the wound roll that gives an Instant Death wound

special_rules.text: If a weapon with this special rule rolls a wound roll equal to or greater than the value of X, if that wound is not saved or mitigated, it is treated as an Instant Death Wound. Primarch, Monster, & Walker type units suffer D3 wounds instead.

special_rules.name: Ammo

parameter.description: the number of times that the weapon can be used in a game

special_rules.text: A Weapon with this special rule can only be used a number of times in a game equal to X.

special_rules.name: Indirect Fire
special_rules.text:
A weapon with this trait may opt to fire indirectly. The weapon does not need Line of Sight to targets when picking targets for attacks in the shooting phase (see 8.2). However, the model or unit suffers -1 modifier to hit rolls against targets it cannot see.

For resolving casualties and allocating wounds, Indirect Fire weapons ignore the requirements on visibility when allocating wounds (see 9.1). Indirect Fire weapons may fire beyond Night Fighting Range.

Indirect Fire weapons use the final placement of the target marker to determine the AV facing (Side AV if the hit is direct), are hit and what Cover Saves a model might get (the final marker determines Line of Sight for Cover Saves).

special_rules.name: Lance
special_rules.text: Weapons with this special rule count a Vehicle, Titan, Aircraft, or Knight type units Armour Value that is higher than 12 as 12.

special_rules.name: Macro
special_rules.text: A weapon with this special rule has +2 to the roll when rolling on the Vehicle damage chart or Titan Damage chart. Macro weapons ignore the Super Heavy special rule and any Super Heavy Structure points a target has for determining of they would be destroyed from an attack.

special_rules.name: Master-Crafted
special_rules.text: A weapon with this special rule may re-roll 1 hit roll per phase. Spray weapons with this special rule may re-roll 1 wound roll per phase instead.

special_rules.name: Melta
special_rules.text: A weapon with the Melta special rule has +2 to its Strength characteristic when within half range or melee (see 8.5.7).

special_rules.name: Ordnance
special_rules.text: A model equipped with a weapon that has the Ordnance special rule must remain stationary to Shoot in the Shooting Phase. A model that fires an Ordnance Weapon cannot charge in the Charge Phase. Ordnance weapons may not be fired a Snapshot, on Overwatch or into engaged models within 3".

special_rules.name: Poison

parameter.description: the roll that always wounds

special_rules.text:
A weapon with this special rule always wounds on a roll of X as represented next to the rule. Poison weapons use their normal Strength against Vehicles, Aircraft, Drones, Knights, Titans, Automata & Walkers however.

If when comparing the weapons Strength characteristic against the targets Toughness or Armour Value characteristic, the wound roll required is lower than the Poison roll indicated in the brackets or vice-versa, use the lowest required to Wound or Penetrate roll for determining if the weapon inflicts a wound on the target. Poison (X) is not considered a triggered effect (see 1.7.4).

special_rules.name: Precision Hits
special_rules.text: When allocating attacks, if the attacking model causes a wound with a weapon that has this special rule, the player controlling the attacking unit may dictate which models in the target unit must have the wounds allocated to them in (see 9.1).

special_rules.name: Psychic Weapon
special_rules.text: This weapon counts as a Psychic Power for any rules that would affect Psychic Powers. To make a Shooting Attack with a weapon that has this special rule must pass a Psychic Test as if they were casting a Psychic Power (see Psyker (x) special rule). If the test is failed, the equipped model may not make an attack with this weapon that phase. This counts towards the number of Psychic Powers a Psyker may cast each Shooting Phase. Note that the Psychic Test for casting a Psychic Weapon can result in a Peril of the Warp per normal.

special_rules.name: Pinning
special_rules.text:
A unit that is hit by a weapon with this special rule must make a Pinning test in step 5 of the shooting attack sequence in addition to a panic test:

To make the Pinning test, Roll 2D6. If the roll is equal to or lower than the target units Leadership Characteristic, the test is passed and the attack sequence ends. If the test is failed, place a Pinned marker on the unit.

A pinned unit:

- Halves its Movement (M) characteristic.
- Has -1 to hit rolls with all Shooting attacks.
- May not make Reactions in the Charge phase and any currently set reactions are cancelled.

Remove the Pinned Marker from a unit at the end of units controller's next turn. Regardless of the number of tests failed, a unit can only ever have 1 Pinned marker. A unit only ever makes 1 Pinning test per unit shooting attack in step 5 of the attack sequence.

(Example: A unit with 5 Heavy Bolters targets a Guardsman squad. The Guard make 1 Pinning test after all Heavy Bolter shots have been resolved. In the same phase, the next unit targets the same Guardsman squad with 2 pinning weapons. After all shooing attacks are resolved, the guard squad makes 1 Pinning test.)

special_rules.name: Reach
special_rules.text: A model with this weapon has a melee range of 2" instead of 1".

special_rules.name: Rending

parameter.description: the unmodified wound roll that is resolved at AP2

special_rules.text:
When a weapon with this special rule rolls an unmodified roll equal to (x) to wound, that wound is resolved at AP2 instead of its normal AP value (see 8.5.1).

If rolling to Penetrate against an Armour Value, the weapons attack against the target is resolved with +1 to the weapons Strength characteristic for determining if the weapon caused a Penetrating hit on a roll of (x).

special_rules.name: Shred
special_rules.text: A weapon with Shred can re-roll all wound rolls (see 8.5).

special_rules.name: Skyfire
special_rules.text: A weapon with this special rule can fire at Aircraft with its full Ballistic Skill (see 8.2.3). A unit that set to Overwatch may fire this weapon at Aircraft units with its full range instead of 12". A weapon with the Blast or Spray special rule loses this special rule if they gain the Skyfire special rule. A Skyfire weapon suffers -1 to its hit rolls against units without the Fly special rule.

special_rules.name: Specialist Weapon
special_rules.text: A model equipped with a weapon with this special rule does not gain the extra +1 attack benefit of equipped with more than 1 melee weapon unless all melee weapons they are equipped with have this special rule.

special_rules.name: Spray
special_rules.text:
Instead of rolling to hit normally with a weapon with this trait during step 1 of the shooting attack sequence (see 8.5), a weapon with this special rule chooses the unit being targeted by the Spray weapon. The weapon hits once for each model in the unit that is within range of the spray weapon up to a max of 5 automatic hits per weapon. Roll to wound and Saves as normal. Spray weapons ignore cover saves.

When performing Overwatch, a Spray weapon automatically inflicts its max 5 number of hits instead of measuring number of targets instead. Spray weapons can never target Aircraft. Spray weapons cannot make Snap Shots.

special_rules.name: Swift Strike
special_rules.text: A weapon with this special rule always strikes at initiative step 6 in the Fight Sequence unless the equipped model's Initiative (I) characteristic is higher (see 12.1).

special_rules.name: Combi
special_rules.text: A model may fire both profiles of a weapon with this special rule even if they do not have the Firing Protocols (X) special rule.

special_rules.name: Deflagrate
special_rules.text: After the attacks of this weapon have been resolved, count the number of unsaved wounds caused on the target. Immediately resolve a number of automatic hits against the target unit equal to that number. These hits use the Strength and AP of the weapon with this special rule. These special hits do not themselves inflict any additional hits, nor benefit from any other special rules possessed by the attacking model or the weapon.

special_rules.name: Linked
special_rules.text: A weapon with this special rule may re-roll all hit rolls. A Linked weapon with the Spray special rule can score a max 10 hits instead 5.

special_rules.name: Parry
special_rules.text: If a model or unit that includes models equipped with a weapon with this special rule is attacked in the Combat Phase, the equipped unit counts its Weapon Skill (WS) or majority Weapon Skill (WS) as 1 Higher for the purposes of determining the required to hit roll against the equipped model or its unit.

special_rules.name: Sunder
special_rules.text: A Weapon with the Sunder special rule re-rolls Penetration rolls.

special_rules.name: Sweeping

parameter.description: the number of additional attacks

special_rules.text: A model attacking with a weapon with this special rule makes an additional number of attacks equal to the value of (x) with this weapon if the target unit has 3 or more models in the target unit.

special_rules.name: Two-Handed
special_rules.text: A model attacking with a weapon with this special rule does not count towards or gain the benefit of being equipped with Multiple Melee weapons or Pistols.

special_rules.name: Unwieldy
special_rules.text: A model's Initiative (I) characteristic is reduced to 1 when declaring that it will make attacks with a weapon with this special rule at the start of the Fight Sequence (see 12.1).

special_rules.name: Variable
special_rules.text: When firing this weapon, you must select which mode you will use for that attack.

special_rules.name: Limited

parameter.description: the scope of the limit: 1 per detachment or 1 per army

special_rules.text: Some units may have a limit imposed on them which is listed as part of the unit's special rules on its data sheet. Some units may be limited by other factors. Limitations of how many of a unit you can bring are divided between being Limited 1 per detachment and limited to 1 per army. Some units may be limited by time period as well. Units limited by Time period will indicate via the keyword in brackets if they are general limited or only limited in specific time periods. They will be limited from time period onwards into future time periods but not in previous time periods.
